## Server timing: native request vs data layer

The document's Server-Timing header reports elapsed time on the server from receipt of the request to response headers (`serverHeaderMs`). Data layer: the SSR villa read (getVilla) inside that response; its Convex round trip splits into connection/transport (round trip − server completion) and server completion, whose uncached handler time covers query and database work.

## Critical path

Each run's interval is partitioned at its observed milestones, so overlapping work is attributed once to the milestone that ended the wait. Medians of segments need not sum to the median total. `drag_started` includes harness wait between scene readiness and the automated drag. `first_panorama_response_end` is the first panorama response end in the interval, omitted from a run with any cache-served (warm) panorama transfer. `texture_available` marks texture acquisition (fetched and handed to the renderer), not GPU decode.
